name: Cylinder Gallery
description: Full-screen WebGL gallery where hundreds of image cards orbit around a cylinder that scrolls with the mouse wheel, with a featured image plane in the center.
contents: Canvas with instanced image cards arranged in rings around a cylinder
Center image plane that changes as you scroll
behavior: Mouse wheel speeds up and reverses the motion with smoothing
Center image cycles with scroll progress
editableByProps: Images, background color, cylinder size and card count
Card and center plane dimensions, camera, speeds and smoothing
Whether wheel events scroll the page

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how cards are placed on the cylinder
Change how the center image is chosen

fixed: Listens to wheel events on window and, with preventPageScroll on, blocks page scrolling while mounted. Listeners are removed on unmount
